title: नेपाली धातुकला विधि र परम्परा [Nepali Metalwork Method and Tradition]
nepali: मूर्ति रचना पद्धतिका सन्दर्भमा नेपालमा धातुकलाको निकै लामो र विशिष्ट परम्परा रहिआएको छ ।धातुकलामा ढलाइ (Casting) पद्धति र पाता अर्थात् रिपोसे (Sand casting) पद्धति प्रचलित रहेका छन् । स्यान्ड कास्टिङ (Sand casting)  लाई ढलान पद्धतिमा वैकल्पिक विधिका रूपमा लिइन्छ । धातुमूर्ति रचना पद्धतिमा मैन निर्गम पद्धति (Lost wax Process) को अलगै महत्व रहेको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययन मैन निर्गम पद्धतिको परम्परामा केन्द्रित रहेको छ । ढलाइ पद्धति साँचामा पग्लेको धातु खन्याई मैनको ‘मानसरा’ मा मधुच्छिष्ट विधानम् भनी उल्लेख गरिएको पाइन्छ । यस पद्धतिलाई फ्रान्सेली भाषामा ‘सेर पर्डु’ (cere-perdue) र अङ्ग्रेजी भाषामा (lost wax process)भनिन्छ । ऐतिहासिकताका दृष्टिले सिन्धुघाटी सभ्यताको मोहेन्जोदारोमा प्राप्त २५०० इस्वी संवत्पूर्वको ‘नर्तकी’ नाम दिइएको धातु मूर्ति सर्वाधिक प्राचीन मानिएको छ । मैन निर्गम पद्धतिबाट गठित तथाखोक्रो दुबै खालका मूर्ति बनाउन सकिन्छ । यो पद्धति भारतका बिभिन्न आदिवासी समुदायमा पनि ‘डोकरा कास्टिङ’ नामले प्रचलित रहेको पाइन्छ । आधुनिक पद्धतिका तुलनामा यो पद्धति कम खर्चिलोभए तापनि परम्परागत पद्धतिमा केही चुनौतीहरू पनि रहेका छन् ।
american_english: In the context of sculpting methods, metal art in Nepal has had a very long and distinguished tradition. In metal art, casting methods and sheet metal or repoussé (sand casting) methods are prevalent. Sand casting is taken as an alternative method within casting techniques. In the metal sculpture making process, the lost-wax process holds a distinct importance. The present study is focused on the tradition of the lost-wax process. In the casting method, pouring molten metal into a mold is found mentioned as Madhucchishta Vidhanam in the wax section of the 'Manasara.' This method is called 'cire perdue' in French and 'lost wax process' in English. From a historical perspective, the metal statue named 'Dancing Girl' dating back to 2500 BCE, unearthed in Mohenjo-daro of the Indus Valley Civilization, is considered the most ancient. Both solid and hollow statues can be crafted using the lost-wax process. This process is also found to be prevalent under the name 'Dhokra casting' among various indigenous communities in India. Although this method is less expensive compared to modern methods, there are still certain challenges in the traditional process.

informal_english: When it comes to sculpting techniques, Nepal's got a pretty long and distinctive metalcraft tradition. This method is called 'cire perdue' in French and 'lost wax process' in English. translator_notes: Strict sentence order preserved (11 sentences). Source contains erroneous gloss pairing repoussé with sand casting ('पाता अर्थात् रिपोसे (Sand casting)'); both are translated verbatim. Devanagari Sanskrit/technical terms ('मानसरा', 'मधुच्छिष्ट विधानम्') are transliterated as Manasara and Madhucchishta Vidhanam. The French term 'सेर पर्डु (cere-perdue)' rendered as 'cire perdue'. Informal flavour: Australian casual.
